TrSS GAME LIBRARY — THIRD-PARTY TELEMETRY COMPONENT
====================================================

Component: PresentMon Console Application
Pinned release: 2.6.0
Upstream project: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon
Release: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/releases/tag/v2.6.0
Upstream source license: MIT
Pinned Windows x64 binary SHA-256:
b2a706bc6ad475749e3b7e3409263aa1e6906d45bdcf993f6dbc0f660188f1af

TrSS Game Library bundles the PresentMon console collector as a background component
to read Windows ETW frame-present events for the selected game. It has no separate
user-facing window in this application. The raw telemetry CSV is temporary local state
and is deleted when tracking stops. No telemetry is uploaded by TrSS Game Library.

The bundled component remains licensed under the MIT license below. PresentMon is an
upstream open-source project; it is not authored by Tamasrazim.
